name: Rhudaur, Massive Doors
desc1: This is a small plaza facing the entrance doors to the cursed city of
desc2: Rhudaur. Ages ago, the people of this city were abandoned by the gods
desc3: for their multitude of evil crimes. Now, it is a haven for the cruel,
desc4: wicked, and generally sleazy outcasts of the Western World. Torches
desc5: affixed to the walls here provide a flickering light. To the south,
desc6: the plaza turns into a wide street, and dark, narrow alleyways lead
desc7: off to the east and west.
